critical_code_review_comments: Monthly billing preview correctly folds in previous month's pending balance into prev-balance column, then Generate atomically allocates sequential invoice numbers (SHPG-2026-0005..0009 assigned back-to-back).

Overdue endpoint declared before /api/invoices/{inv_id} route (correct FastAPI ordering) — smoke curl confirms /api/invoices/overdue returns structured JSON not 404.
waReminderLink builds wa.me URL with only encoded text (no phone-number leak in text body), uses mobile only in the wa.me/91<num> path — correct.
CSV_AUTO_MAP correctly maps all real Google Forms columns (Full Name, Guest Mobile Number, Monthly Rent, Security Deposit, Room / Bed Number) — 3/3 preview rows populated correctly.
Food orders with status=Cancelled correctly excluded from day totals AND monthly food aggregation feeding billing — verified via UI total flip 2→0.

Backup export.settings does NOT include SMTP_USER/SMTP_APP_PASSWORD as values (only businessName/ownerEmail/etc.). The substring 'SMTP_APP_PASSWORD' appears only inside invoice.emailError user-facing hint — acceptable and helpful for the operator.
